svg.title: LILYGO T-Deck Plus V1.0 (T-Deck-Plus) front drawing, 1:1 mm
svg.desc: Front of the LILYGO T-Deck Plus V1.0 (T-Deck-Plus) drawn at 1:1 scale (1 SVG unit = 1 mm): case, screen, keys, ports and printed legends. Part of Kleidos boards. LILYGO and T-Deck are trademarks of their owner; Kleidos is not affiliated with LILYGO.
